body: If user switches off IPv6 and initiates tox, the requests to to the IPv6 bootstrap nodes is still done, which results in a lot of warning messages in the log. In this PR we check if this is the case before calling `net_send_packet`, hence avoiding the warning. Related to https://github.com/TokTok/c-toxcore/issues/1432 - - - This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/TokTok/c-toxcore/3032)

1. There are more than just this function.
2. move this up right after unpacking send_to, we can skip the whole rng and encryption thing

Add a note to only use this for udp sockets.

Toxcore also uses virtual families that are not checked by this function.
3. we probably want to at least log a trace message here.
